cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import re
def parse_filter(f):
    rows=[]
    for m in re.finditer(r'\(\"([^\"]+)\" = \"([^\"]+)\")', f):
        rows.append((m.group(1), m.group(2)))
    for m in re.finditer(r'\(\"([^\"]+)\" IN LIST ([^\)]+)\)', f):
        cols=m.group(1)
        vals=[v.strip() for v in m.group(2).split(',')]
        rows.append((cols, vals))
    return rows

for f in ['(\"orgId\" = \"LIM\") AND (\"careType\" = \"AMSTER\") AND (\"contextId\" IN LIST 98);',
          '(\"orgId\" = \"OMG\") AND (\"careType\" = \"AMSTER\") AND (\"specialtyId\" IN LIST 66,77) AND (\"contextId\" IN LIST 55,689,213);',
          '(\"careType\" = \"AMSTER\") AND (\"loc\" IN LIST 5) AND (\"orgId\" = \"ACC\") AND (\"contextId\" IN LIST 122) AND (\"specialtyId\" IN LIST 03,056);']:
    print(parse_filter(f))
"
